gaps.gap: The refresh path is implemented and deliberate — Analytics.tsx subscribes to /api/events/stream via subscribeToEvents, coalesces reloads at 400ms so a sweep routing fifty leads costs one aggregate query rather than fifty, and shows a 'Live' indicator once a frame has arrived. The stream itself is covered by server/tests/unit/eventStream.test.ts and its api_definition is declared manual. WHAT HAS NO EXECUTABLE ARTIFACT is the refresh actually happening: scenario 1fca44d2 passed in a real browser, but its steps only prove the two push-refreshed panels RENDER. 'Live' is set only on a real data frame — not on connect and not on a heartbeat comment frame — and a linear single-tab BDD run cannot produce one, because the event would have to arrive while Analytics is already mounted and the runner has one tab and no way to act as a second operator. Proving it would need either a component harness the client does not have (no @testing-library/react, no jsdom — adding both is a dependency change outside this task) or a two-actor browser test the runner does not support. The limit is now written into tests/features/basic-analytics-dashboard.feature as a COVERAGE NOTE so it is visible in the artifact rather than only in this record.
